adaptive NKG2C1 NK cells were demonstrated to be enriched for NKG2A– and CD571 cells and are consequently considered terminally differentiated
The initial description of adaptive NKG2C1 NK cells in HCMV-seropositive healthy individuals included reduced proportions of cells expressing the natural cytotoxicity receptor NKp30 (CD337)
as well as increased frequencies of ILT2 (CD85j)-expressing cells
In-depth phenotypical analyses have demonstrated that adaptive NK cells preferentially lack the inhibitory receptor Siglec-7
analysis of large cohorts has revealed a slightly increased proportion of CD21 cells within adaptive NK-cell subsets
and that CD7 is expressed at lower levels per cell
